hero.subtitle: Industrial IoT • React Native
hero.title: Apollo CarMix
hero.tagline: Mobile app for operators of CarMix self-loading concrete mixers. IoT sensor monitoring, concrete recipe management, quality certificate generation.

seo.title: Apollo CarMix — IoT app for concrete plants
seo.description: React Native app for mobile concrete plants: IoT telemetry, mix recipes, certification.

overview.title: About the project
overview.description: Apollo CarMix is an app for the Italian mobile concrete plant manufacturer CarMix. Operators on construction sites manage concrete mixing, monitor sensor readings, and generate quality certificates directly from their phone.

solution.title: What was built
solution.description: React Native mobile app connected to equipment IoT sensors.

features.title: Real-time sensor monitoring
features.description: Data from load cells (weighing), engine diagnostics, GPS coordinates. Visualized through live gauges in the app.

features.title: Concrete recipe management
features.description: Storage and selection of mix recipes with ingredient proportion control. Automatic water-cement ratio adjustment.

features.title: Certificate generation
features.description: Generating concrete quality certificates (RMC Plant Standard) with composition data, coordinates, and mix timestamps.

impact.title: Outcome
impact.description: App published on the App Store and Google Play. Used by CarMix concrete plant operators.

achievements.title: Live industrial product
achievements.description: Running on real construction sites connected to equipment IoT sensors

achievements.title: Digital documentation
achievements.description: Automated certificate generation replaces manual paperwork
